title: Pomodoro Timer
seoTitle: Free Pomodoro Timer — 25 Minute Focus Sessions
description: Classic Pomodoro timer with 25-minute work sessions and 5-minute breaks. Start, pause and reset locally in your browser for better focus.
intro: Set a work interval and break length, then start the timer. A simple focus tool that stays private on your device.
blurb: Run focused 25-minute work sessions with short breaks using the Pomodoro technique.
howItWorks: Set your preferred work and break durations (defaults are 25 and 5 minutes).
Click Start to begin a work session. The timer counts down in your browser.
When the session ends, start a break. Pause or reset at any time. Nothing is stored or uploaded.
examples: Use the classic 25/5 cycle to write an essay or code a feature.
Shorten work to 15 minutes for quick tasks and keep 5-minute breaks.
After four work sessions, take a longer 15-minute break.

faq.q: Does the timer keep running if I leave the tab?
faq.a: Modern browsers may throttle timers in background tabs. For best accuracy, keep the tab open or in the foreground.

faq.q: Is any data saved or sent to a server?
faq.a: No. The timer runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. No account, no storage, no uploads.

faq.q: Can I change the times while the timer is running?
faq.a: Changing the numbers applies on the next Start or Reset. Pause first if you want to adjust mid-session.
